شَرَطِىٌّ Of, or relating to, [the asterism called]
the شَرَطَان and the أَشْرَاط; as also ↓ أَشْرَاطِىٌّ ; the latter being formed from the pl., (IB, TA,) because the stars thus called are regarded as composing one thing. (TA.) You say, رَوْضَةٌ ↓ أَشْرَاطِيَّةٌ , meaning [A garden, or meadow, &c.,] rained upon by the نَوْء [q. v.] of the شَرَطَان. (S. TA.) In the A we find ↓ نَوْءٌ شِرَاطِىٌّ : but probably it should be شَرَطِىٌّ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
